opening.argument: The video presents Shopkick as a conventional rewards app in which users earn kicks through ordinary store activities and redeem them for retail gift cards. The speaker explains that “you get points by just going in the store” and that users “can redeem those points for gift-cards to places like Target, Sephora.” The described participation includes scanning product barcodes, an optional debit-card link that awards kicks for purchases, and a referral offer tied to three sign-ups. Although viewers are directed to download the app through a link, the available evidence frames that link and referral offer as participation conditions, not requests for payment, credentials, or investment. The supplied app imagery likewise shows store-finding and gift-card rewards. Nothing available establishes deceptive conduct or a conflicting delivered offer.
